name: El Dorado
description: Supermarket chain in Uruguay with an online store on the VTEX platform, selling groceries, beverages, household and personal care products. Groceries are delivered only to enabled zones; appliances ship across the country by agency. Stores pickup is free for orders above a stated threshold.
description_es: Cadena de supermercados de Uruguay con tienda online sobre la plataforma VTEX, que vende comestibles, bebidas, limpieza y cuidado personal. Los comestibles se entregan solo en zonas habilitadas; los electrodomésticos se envían a todo el país por agencia. El retiro en sucursal es gratuito por encima de un monto indicado.

ships_to.notes: Groceries only to enabled delivery zones; appliances ship to the whole country by agency. Zones not listed in the FAQ.

fulfillment.pickup_notes: Store pickup free per the offers page; pickup for online orders at branches stated as free above a threshold.

sources.supports: grocery delivery limited to enabled zones, appliances nationwide by agency
free store pickup and shipping thresholds
